## Pickering Fall 2023 Series

This competition is in a series with [Pickering Fall A 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PickeringFallA2023). You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these two competitions. ***Attempting to register for both of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.***

### Registration Reminders

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted and registration fees will not be transferred across competitions. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

### Mailing List

We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in southern Ontario and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

venue.name: [CFTA Milano](https://www.cfta.it/)
venue.address: Via Mauro Macchi, 30, 20214 Milano MI, Italy

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaGxSIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ba797d1960b830f32121a41c1d9339fac6aa00af/0.png)

![Image description](https://i.imgur.com/YSp2SyW.png)

This is a quiet events competition and it's *not* newcomer friendly. There will be **NO 3x3** or other classic events, so if you are NOT interested in Fewest Moves solving please consider not registering.

**Note: you will have to pay 10€ extra at the venue if you are not a Cubing Italy member.**
Membership is free! More info in the [Registration tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MiniMentalMilanoI2023#34115-registration-registrazione-faq).

---

![Image description](http://i.imgur.com/yztC4Jt.png)

Questa è una competizione di eventi "silenziosi" e non è adatta per una prima esperienza. **NON ci saranno il 3x3** o altri eventi classici, quindi se non siete interessati al 3x3 Fewest Moves per favore prendete in considerazione l'idea di non registrarvi.

**Nota: dovrai pagare altri 10€ in loco se non sei un socio di Cubing Italy.**
Associarsi è gratis! Scopri come nella [Sezione Registrazione](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MiniMentalMilanoI2023#34115-registration-registrazione-faq).

items.name: DeKalb Cubing Fall 2023
items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DeKalbCubingFall2023#17574-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

You can find out about upcoming competitions in our area in our local Facebook group: [Wisconsin and Illinois Speedcubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/2382471798653473).

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).
